modules.module_title: Carry out preliminary, primary and secondary water treatment

pcs.pc_description: Draw water in the appropriate quantity from the wastewater source, such as a river or lake.
Carry out preliminary treatment of water, using bar screens and mechanical rakes to remove large debris such as rags, plastics, and other solid waste.
Carry out primary treatment of wastewater using primary clarifiers and sedimentation tanks.
Skim off oils and greases floating on the top of the water using the appropriate tools and equipment.
Aerate the water using diffused/ mechanical aerators or oxidation ditches to break down organic matter.
Carry out secondary sedimentation by transferring water to secondary clarifiers where to remove activated sludge.
Remove the remaining suspended solids and contaminants using sand filters, activated carbon filters, or membrane filters
Remove nutrients like nitrogen and phosphorus by following the appropriate biological or chemical processes to prevent eutrophication.
Eliminate the remaining pathogens using chlorine, Ultraviolet (UV) light, or ozone, as appropriate.

Break down odour-causing compounds in water using bio-filters with microorganisms
Neutralize odorous gases using chemical scrubbers
Adsorb odorous compounds activated carbon filters
